tools.description: Is this wallet, X account or person trustworthy? Ethos credibility score (0 to 2800) and level, from untrusted to renowned, built from peer reviews, ETH-backed vouches, slashes and linked on-chain and social history. tools.name: ethos_user_by_x
tools.description: Who is behind an X (Twitter) handle, and can they be trusted? The Ethos profile for a handle or numeric account id: display name, credibility score and status, every wallet address and social account linked to the same person, XP, influence factor, and how many positive, neutral and negative reviews

tools.name: ethos_search_users
tools.description: Find a person or project on Ethos when you only have a name, a partial handle or part of an address.
